x: Bob Plummer after scaring the daylights out of us up to ten miles, really showed us a thing or two from twelve onwards. Jim MacDonald and Bert Jordan, although not at their best, plugged away with typical courage.

As a complete result did not appear in the last issue of the magazine, we take the liberty of supplying the missing details. In addition to Collis, Gebbett and Plummer whose positions and times were given, the following members completed the course:- 44th.

2.0 ALL OUR YESTERDAYS Tom Carter Edward Stimpson Tom Morell Ernie Duffett George Chantler 7.45 TOP TEAM Macdonald, Baker, Piddington Plummer. 10.0 LATE NIGHT EXTRA or NIGHT RIDE with Peter Hillier & Company

Once off, however, they tore down the Embankment like the wind, and as the field reached the coloured lights of Albert Bridge, twinklingly reflected in the dark Thames below, our Belgrave heroes - McDonald, Plummer, 'Boofer' Bruce, etc. - could be seen bounding along like young gazelles.
